anti_patterns_avoided.name: shared_instance_multi_tenant_canvas

anti_patterns_avoided.risk: cross-tenant data exposure via shared execution context or credential bleed

anti_patterns_avoided.name: last_writer_wins_concurrent_edit
anti_patterns_avoided.citation: None of these products expose a CRDT or OT model; concurrent save = silent overwrite

anti_patterns_avoided.avoidance_mechanism: CRDT (yrs/loro) with explicit conflict UI when auto-merge fails (AC-06); test_no_silent_overwrite CI lane

anti_patterns_avoided.name: python_code_as_workflow_canonical_authority
anti_patterns_avoided.citation: airflow.apache.org/docs/stable/ui.html — Code Tab shows Python DAG definition
anti_patterns_avoided.risk: workflow logic cannot be authored visually, LLM-generated, or schema-validated; editor is monitoring-only
anti_patterns_avoided.avoidance_mechanism: canonical JSON spec (workflow_spec.v1.json) is source of truth; visual and Python are projections only; round-trip CI lane enforces

anti_patterns_avoided.name: ecosystem_lock_in_as_workflow_substrate
anti_patterns_avoided.observed_in: Microsoft Power Automate (Microsoft-ecosystem-only connectors and Dataverse)
anti_patterns_avoided.citation: learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/flow-types — Power Platform integration is the connector surface
anti_patterns_avoided.risk: customers cannot migrate or run workflows on non-Microsoft infrastructure; vendor lock-in
anti_patterns_avoided.avoidance_mechanism: open workflow_spec.v1.json format; capability registry is open (any Foundry capability); no proprietary runtime SDK required by workflow definition

anti_patterns_avoided.name: monitoring_only_ui_no_authoring_canvas
anti_patterns_avoided.citation: airflow.apache.org/docs/stable/ui.html — UI is grid/graph view for monitoring; DAGs authored externally in Python
anti_patterns_avoided.risk: business users and non-engineers cannot create or modify workflows; forces engineering dependency
anti_patterns_avoided.avoidance_mechanism: WorkflowCanvas authoring variant is the primary surface; visual → spec round-trip guaranteed; no code required for basic workflows (AC-01)

anti_patterns_avoided.name: app_builder_primary_workflow_secondary
anti_patterns_avoided.citation: retool.com/products/workflows — Workflows is one feature within Retool app-builder platform
anti_patterns_avoided.risk: workflow features are deprioritized; no standalone deployment; tied to app-builder licensing model
anti_patterns_avoided.avoidance_mechanism: Workflow Studio is a first-class standalone product with its own crate family, API surface, and licensing (per-seat + per-active-definition)

anti_patterns_avoided.name: connector_breadth_without_data_class_metadata
anti_patterns_avoided.citation: zapier.com/features; docs.n8n.io/workflows — connectors lack data_class / PII annotations
anti_patterns_avoided.risk: workflows silently move PII or regulated data through connectors without author awareness; compliance breach
anti_patterns_avoided.avoidance_mechanism: every connector/capability-call node exposes data_class field; Cedar policy preview fires when data_class = PII or REGULATED (AC-07); oya-governance-cedar-preview-required lane

anti_patterns_avoided.name: no_machine_readable_workflow_spec
anti_patterns_avoided.citation: None expose a schema-validated open workflow format; definitions are stored in proprietary internal representations
anti_patterns_avoided.risk: LLM authoring impossible; git-based review impossible; editor cannot guarantee round-trip fidelity
anti_patterns_avoided.avoidance_mechanism: workflow_spec.v1.json with JSON Schema 2020-12; byte-equal round-trip CI lane (AC-02); LLM submission validated before editor render (AC-05)

anti_patterns_avoided.name: spinner_only_loading_on_critical_path
anti_patterns_avoided.observed_in: Make.com (TTI ~3.5s with blank canvas until fully loaded)
anti_patterns_avoided.citation: help.make.com/scenarios — scenario builder loads modules sequentially
anti_patterns_avoided.risk: perceived performance degradation; user abandonment on large definitions
anti_patterns_avoided.avoidance_mechanism: canvas/layout skeletons + descriptor progressive loading; spinner-only loading forbidden on critical path (user_experience.loading_state_coverage)

anti_patterns_avoided.name: unredacted_sensitive_data_in_execution_history
anti_patterns_avoided.observed_in: n8n (execution data visible to all users with workflow access by default)
anti_patterns_avoided.citation: docs.n8n.io/workflows/executions — data redaction is opt-in, not default
anti_patterns_avoided.risk: secrets or PII exposed in execution logs to unauthorized viewers
anti_patterns_avoided.avoidance_mechanism: execution_data_redaction_flag per execution record; Cedar policy controls who can view unredacted history; redaction is on-by-default for data_class = PII or SECRET

hyperscaler_bar.rationale: Production enterprise workflows (supply-chain, healthcare orchestration) regularly exceed 1000 nodes; Palantir Foundry pipelines routinely hit 10k+ steps
hyperscaler_bar.target: canvas render of 10,000-node workflow completes in <100ms p99 (60fps interaction); virtualized node rendering mandatory
hyperscaler_bar.verification: synthetic canvas bench: generate 10k-node spec, measure first-render and pan/zoom p99 in headless browser harness

hyperscaler_bar.rationale: Linear-grade responsiveness: every user interaction (node select, drag, edge draw) must feel instant; Figma achieves <16ms at 60fps; we target <50ms p99
hyperscaler_bar.target: <50ms p99 for all canvas interaction ops: node drag, edge connect, config panel open, zoom
hyperscaler_bar.verification: cargo bench canvas-interaction-p99 via headless Leptos WASM harness

hyperscaler_bar.rationale: Stripe-grade multi-tenant: 10k simultaneous editors sharing per-tenant cell infrastructure without noisy-neighbor degradation
hyperscaler_bar.target: 10,000 concurrent editor sessions per region; p99 save latency stays <100ms under full load
hyperscaler_bar.verification: canary load-test: 10k concurrent WebSocket editor sessions; measure save p99 and CRDT merge latency

hyperscaler_bar.rationale: Collaborative editing (Google Docs-grade): CRDT merge must be imperceptible to users; yrs/loro can achieve <5ms for typical document sizes
hyperscaler_bar.target: <10ms p99 CRDT merge for concurrent edits on 1000-node workflow spec

hyperscaler_bar.rationale: Google-grade TTI: users in any region (including KR) must reach interactive canvas in <2s cold; CDN edge cache + WASM streaming required
hyperscaler_bar.target: TTI <2s p99 cold start globally (GA); <3s preview; node library progressive loading within 500ms of canvas interactive
hyperscaler_bar.verification: synthetic Lighthouse budget via cargo nextest; CDN-hit verification per region

hyperscaler_bar.rationale: AWS-grade tenancy isolation: no editor session may observe another tenant's node data, execution history, or ontology descriptors at any layer (render, CRDT state, WebSocket, CDN cache key)
hyperscaler_bar.target: cross_tenant_leak_count = 0 at all waves; per-tenant CDN cache key; WebSocket session scoped to tenant cell
hyperscaler_bar.verification: cargo nextest test_no_cross_tenant_leak; CDN cache-key audit; WebSocket session isolation test

hyperscaler_bar.rationale: Stripe-grade secrets: credential values (API keys, tokens) must never appear in editor CRDT state, execution history, or browser memory as plaintext
hyperscaler_bar.target: all credential fields in node config panels use SecretRef type; plaintext value never round-trips through editor; secrets resolved at engine execution time only
hyperscaler_bar.verification: oya-governance-cedar-preview-required: grep CRDT state and editor_event.v1.json for raw secret patterns; static analysis lane

hyperscaler_bar.rationale: Linear-grade accessibility: every canvas operation, node config, diff view, replay, and policy preview must be keyboard-operable; screen-reader compatible node graph (aria-label on every edge and node)
hyperscaler_bar.target: 100% keyboard navigation coverage; WCAG 2.2 AA in both dark and light themes; axe-core CI scan zero violations
hyperscaler_bar.verification: axe-core automated scan in CI; manual keyboard navigation audit per component at each wave

hyperscaler_bar.rationale: Palantir-grade large-graph UX: loading a 1000-node pipeline definition into the editor must complete in <200ms; requires streaming parse + virtual canvas
hyperscaler_bar.target: <200ms spec parse + initial render for 1000-node workflow_spec.v1.json; streaming JSON parse mandatory above 500 nodes
hyperscaler_bar.verification: cargo bench definition-load-p99 with generated 1000-node corpus

hyperscaler_bar.rationale: Stripe-grade SLA: editor availability 99.95% equates to <26 minutes downtime/month; auto-rollback canary must trigger within 60s of regression detection
hyperscaler_bar.target: editor_availability_slo_pct = 99.95% at GA; MTTR <60s via auto-rollback canary (ADR-0114)
hyperscaler_bar.verification: oya gate validate workflow-studio-availability --window 30d; canary-observability-rollback lane
